decisions.statement: A seat is found by the agent's id rather than by the name of its page.
A seat is found through the page type reached by its id rather than by a spelled slug.
A seat is found by the session the seat answers in where no seat has the id.
An id the index does not have is answered with nothing.
A root holding no seat index is refused rather than read as holding no seats.
A value is answered under the key the old system's readers ask by.
A value naming a page is answered as the slug alone, and an assignment whole.
The root is the one the environment states, or the folder the file itself sits in.
A file loaded over the wire states its root, since its own path names no folder.
This module prints one line for each key this module was asked for.
A name reaches a seat's page whether or not that seat has a page yet.
The folder a seat's page sits in is asked of the index rather than spelled here.
A page is a seat by the page type filing it rather than by the folder it sits in.
The mark a supervisor is read from is parted from its start moment by its last `-`.
A mark naming no moment a supervisor started is no supervisor that can be read.
Nothing here reads the seat pages of the old system.

definition: what a seat states, read from the page standing for it here
